leadership.name: Zainab Abdullah
leadership.bio: Zainab leads Devisgon's business direction, bringing the team together around practical client needs and thoughtful delivery.
leadership.message: At Devisgon, our focus is making technology practical for the businesses that use it. We bring AI, automation and software engineering together around business needs, with clear scope and thoughtful delivery. Every project starts with listening, understanding the challenge and agreeing on what a useful result looks like.

leadership.name: Abdullah Sher Muhammad
leadership.bio: Abdullah leads technology and engineering across AI agents, automations and software products, from solution architecture to implementation.
leadership.message: Our approach to technology starts with the problem your team needs to solve. We connect AI, automation and software through clear architecture, careful implementation and practical testing. From the first prototype to deployment, our focus is building systems your team can understand, operate and grow.
